case.title: A Convenient Accident
case.description: The farmhand Vojtech's death was too quickly dismissed as an accident. I must uncover what the locals chose to forget.
objective.search.name: Learn the truth of Vojtech's death
objective.search.active: Someone in the marked area remembers more about Vojtech's death than they are willing to say.
objective.investigation.name: Prove that Vojtech was murdered
objective.target.name: Hunt down Vojtech's killer
objective.target.active: Vojtech's death was no accident. Find the guilty man and carry out the sentence.
objective.target.done: Vojtech's killer is dead. Now no trace can be left behind.
objective.cleanup.name: Leave no trace
objective.cleanup.active: The killing is done. Make certain no one can connect it to Henry.
objective.cleanup.witnessed: Someone saw too much. Witnesses may lead the guards to the truth.
objective.cleanup.clean: No alarm was raised. The case can be closed.
objective.cleanup.controlled: Every dangerous witness is gone. The case can be closed.
objective.cleanup.noisy: The alarm was raised, but the pursuit lost the trail. The case is closed, though not without consequence.
objective.cleanup.external: The guilty man died without Henry's hand. No trail remains.
direction.belongings: The innkeeper said Vojtech's chest remains in the hayloft behind the inn. It may hold what the bailiff chose not to find.
direction.witness: Vojtech wrote that one of the maids witnessed his conversation with the killer. She may be able to identify the man.
dialogue.rumor.prompt: Ask about the unease in the area
dialogue.rumor.henryUnease: People here seem afraid of something. Has something happened?
dialogue.rumor.innkeeperFear: Afraid? Everyone here is afraid of someone: one of the tax collector, another of his own wife. But there is someone whose presence makes even drunks lower their voices.
dialogue.rumor.innkeeperVojtech: A month ago they found a farmhand named Vojtech by the stream. The bailiff decided he had tumbled down the slope while drunk. A convenient explanation - the dead do not argue.
dialogue.rumor.innkeeperRefusal: Someone local. Do not expect a name from me - I have no wish to tumble down a slope while drunk myself one day.
dialogue.rumor.henryWhatToSeek: Then what should I look for?
dialogue.rumor.innkeeperBelongings: Vojtech slept in the hayloft behind the inn. His chest is still there. The bailiff did not even bother to look inside. If the lad knew what was coming, perhaps he left something. Hurry, before the mice learn to read.
dialogue.witness.henryWorking: You were working here the night a man sat down with Vojtech.
dialogue.witness.maidManyNights: I work here most nights. Plenty of men sit down with drunken farmhands.
dialogue.witness.henryLetter: Vojtech left a letter. He wrote that you saw them together.
dialogue.witness.maidFool: Fool… I told him to keep quiet.
dialogue.witness.maidStream: You think I do not know? Every morning since that night, I have looked at the stream and feared I would see someone else in it.
dialogue.witness.maidThreat: The man ordered two mugs. Vojtech never touched his. He leaned close and said, “Even sober men lose their footing by the water.” Then he left a coin and walked away.
dialogue.witness.maidName: Do not make me say his name in here.
dialogue.witness.henryWhere: Then tell me where to find him.
dialogue.witness.maidLocation: I will tell you what he looks like and where to find him. But if he asks, we never spoke.
document.letter.name: Vojtech's Unsent Letter
document.letter.info: A folded sheet hidden among the dead farmhand's belongings.
document.letter.body:
Marta,

you asked why I no longer sleep. I lied to you. It was not the drink.

Three nights ago by the old ford, I saw that man with the merchant's apprentice. The lad was on his knees, begging to be let go. He dragged him into the water and forced his face to the bottom. Twice he let him raise his head and take a breath — only to push him under again. The third time, the boy's hands stopped scraping at the stones.

I was hiding behind the willows. I could have called for help. Could have rushed him. But I lay in the mud with my hand over my mouth and waited for it to end.

Yesterday he found me in the tavern. Sat beside me, ordered two mugs, and said accidents were always happening to drunken farmhands: one falls from a bluff, another drowns in a stream. Then he smiled and paid for my ale.

He knows what I saw.

At dawn I am leaving. If I do not reach you, give this letter to someone who is not afraid to speak his name. The woman clearing tables after sunset saw us together. Perhaps she heard enough.

Forgive me. When I close my eyes, I can still hear the boy's fingernails scraping against the stones.

Vojtech
objective.witness.name: Question the inn workers
objective.witness.active: Vojtech wrote that one of the maids witnessed his conversation with the killer. She may be able to identify the man.
objective.witness.done: The maid confirmed that Vojtech had been threatened and identified the suspect.
journal.rumor: Vojtech's death may not have been an accident. His belongings remain in the inn's hayloft.
journal.letter: Vojtech witnessed a murder and was threatened. One of the inn maids saw his meeting with the killer.
journal.witness: The maid confirmed the threat and identified the man Vojtech saw.
trophy.description: A red feather taken from the killer's body. Vojtech and the drowned apprentice demand no more truth now — only remembrance.
